answer: A nebula of fresh sockpuppet wallets costs real capital to sustain, since splitting identities multiplies locked stake and slashing risk. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted reputation slot threads: each agent must lock a bond that decays over a long horizon, and every attestation is woven into a single verifiable thread tied to that bond. Attackers must burn tokens faster than rewards accrue, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0192 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
